status: SEALED PREDICTION - awaiting owner review count. Do not tune anything on this window.
purpose: First benchmark on a site chosen for COUNTABILITY rather than intersection geometry, and the first where every parameter was derived from measurement before any count existed.

source.camera: SR-41 at Bullard Ave, Caltrans D6, CCTV 41_Bullard
source.tracking: skip=1, imgsz 1920, conf 0.15, yolo11n + pinned configs/tracker.yaml (L-015)

definition.what_is_counted: A vehicle crossing the stream-1 line, moving along +157 deg (the SB 41 mainline), local motion at the crossing within 40 deg of that direction.

everything_derived.direction: motion-weighted mean of 18,288 frames of optical flow
everything_derived.tolerance: per-vehicle crossing headings on the verification segment (p95 24.1, max 26.1); set to 40, mid-PLATEAU - every value 30-89 deg gives an identical count, so this is not a free parameter (L-019)
everything_derived.extent: detection density along the line over the full 609.6 s clip, not a short probe
everything_derived.position: maturity sweep on the verification segment; 55/65/75 all returned NO_MATURE_ZONE, 85 is clean

window_selection.rule: PRE-STATED in docs/protocols/sr41-bullard.md before any count: the 120 s with the most vehicle DETECTIONS in the line bands, from a 25-frame-stride detection pass.

sealed_prediction.sweep_knobs: heading tolerance 20-35 deg x band shift +-40 px
sealed_prediction.note: The sweep is 47-48 across EVERY combination - the count is essentially insensitive to both knobs.
sealed_prediction.sealed_at: 2026-10-05, BEFORE any human count and before the review video was rendered

by_segment.verdict: no_data - the far lanes, see known_limitation

known_limitation: Stream 1's FAR lanes are not countable at this camera. Where they are in frame their tracks are born past any placeable line; where tracks are mature they are out of frame. This number covers the NEAR lanes only and must never be quoted as the full stream-1 volume.
open_for_review: A white SUV crossing around f12038-12047 (conf 0.79-0.87) could not be matched to a track from bounding boxes. The tracker's position leads the detection by a median 33 px, which makes this ambiguous either way - the owner's eyes decide.
Watch for PAIRS of white vehicles travelling together: at one spot on the verification segment a pickup and a car shared a single track.
stream_2_status: NOT SEALED. Stream 2 returned NO_MATURE_ZONE on segment 134.7-202.1 (n=1, born_past=3) on this window, which the protocol says blocks sealing. Its count was 24, sweep 15-24 - the width comes from line POSITION, not the heading threshold (stable 30-31 across 30-35 deg). Stream 2 needs the same position sweep stream 1 got, on verification data.
caveats: Weekday afternoon, free-flow freeway. No congestion, no queues, no turning movements.
Single camera, single clip. Generalisation untested.
N=48 is close to the N>=50 that L-008 wants, but one error is still ~2%.
